items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1964-03-21
items.q: And I used to hold bass for Louis. I'm. Oh. Chris Kelly and all them.

ctx.x: Well I told you that once. Because I tell you why. They used to call me Turk. Turkey Buzzard. Turkey Buzzard. Why? I used to name him Dark and Hansel. But man when I started to pick on that bass. Them cats let me go. I used to sit down. Everybody used to play the piano. I said. Now I'm going to get me something different. I said. Let me play a little piece once in a while. He said. No man. I said. I just got you. Well I said. I'm going to get me something to myself. I got on and I prayed. I said. Lord. What can I…
When did you start with Thomas. When did you start with Thomas.
